title: Honnibrook Mead Cottage
specs: Over twenty meads on tap for sampling
gap: No pricing information for tastings or purchases
blurb: Honnibrook produces craft mead varieties that are light, refreshing, and lower in alcohol. Guests can visit their tasting rooms to sample over twenty meads on tap in a relaxed casual environment. The meadery combines old world craftsmanship with modern technology to create high quality mead.
